```{r}
df_diversity_n_correlation <- data.frame( path = list.files(here("data/disease_criteria"),full.names = T)) %>% 
  mutate(criteria = gsub("_criteria_symptoms\\.csv", "", basename(path))) %>% 
  mutate(data = map(path, read_csv)) %>% 
  unnest(data) %>% 
  select(-path) %>% 
  mutate(feature = str_split(feature, pattern = ", ")) %>% 
  unnest(feature)%>% 
  count(criteria) %>% 
  format_criteria() %>% 
  left_join(plt_div_icd$data, by = "criteria")
```

```{r}
correlation_method <- "pearson"

df_diversity_n_correlation %>% 
  filter(criteria != "MCAS - Alternative") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = n, y = shannon))+
```

```{r, fig.width=8.5, fig.height=3.5}
correlation_method <- "pearson"

df_diversity_n_correlation %>% 
  filter(criteria != "MCAS - Alternative") %>% 
  mutate(group = "Without MCA - Alternative") %>% 
  bind_rows(mutate(df_diversity_n_correlation, group = "With MCA - Alternative")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = n, y = shannon))+
  geom_point(aes(color = criteria, shape = model), size = 3)+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", group = 1, se = F)+
  ggpubr::stat_cor(method = correlation_method, geom = "label")+
  facet_wrap(~group, scales = "free")+
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") + 
  labs(color = "Criteria", shape = "Model", x = "Number of symptoms", y = "Shannon diversity")
```


```{r}
# Calculate full model stats
full_model <- lm(shannon ~ n, data = df_diversity_n_correlation)
full_r2 <- summary(full_model)$r.squared
full_cor <- cor.test(df_diversity_n_correlation$n, df_diversity_n_correlation$shannon)
full_r <- full_cor$estimate
full_pval <- full_cor$p.value

df_correlation_change <- tibble(
  criteria = unique(df_diversity_n_correlation$criteria)
) %>% 
  # Create datasets without each of the indicated criteria
  mutate(data = map(criteria, ~filter(df_diversity_n_correlation, criteria != .))) %>% 
  # Calculate correlation metrics for each of the filtered datasets
  mutate(data = map(data, function(df) {
    cor_without <- cor.test(df$n, df$shannon)
    list(
      "r2_without" = summary(lm(shannon ~ n, data = df))$r.squared,
      "r_without" = cor_without$estimate,
      "pval_without" = cor_without$p.value
    )
  })) %>% 
  unnest_wider(data) %>% 
  # Calculate changes from full dataset
  mutate(
    r_change = full_r - r_without,
    r2_pct_contribution = 100*(full_r2 - r2_without) / full_r2
  ) %>% 
  # mutate(criteria = factor(criteria, levels = criteria_order)) %>% 
  arrange(criteria)
df_correlation_change
```


```{r}
df_influence <- df_diversity_n_correlation %>% 
  nest(.by = model) %>% 
  mutate(data = map(data, function(x){
    x <- column_to_rownames(x, "criteria")
    x <- lm(shannon ~ n, data = x)
    x <- influence.measures(x)
    x <- as.data.frame(x$infmat)
    x <- rownames_to_column(x, "criteria")
    x
  })) %>% 
  unnest(data) %>% 
  select(-model) %>%
  group_by(criteria) 
```
```{r}
df_influence_summary <- df_influence %>% 
  group_by(criteria) %>% 
  summarise_all(mean) %>% 
  arrange(criteria)
df_influence_summary
```

```{r}
# Using Unicode superscripts (limited to certain digits)
# Using Unicode superscripts (limited to certain digits)
format_sci_unicode <- function(x) {
  if (x == 0) return("0")
  
  exponent <- floor(log10(abs(x)))
  coefficient <- x / 10^exponent
  coefficient <- round(coefficient, 1)
  
  # Unicode superscripts
  superscripts <- c("⁰" = 0, "¹" = 1, "²" = 2, "³" = 3, "⁴" = 4,
                   "⁵" = 5, "⁶" = 6, "⁷" = 7, "⁸" = 8, "⁹" = 9,
                   "⁻" = "-")
  
  exp_str <- as.character(exponent)
  exp_chars <- strsplit(exp_str, "")[[1]]
  
  exp_super <- sapply(exp_chars, function(ch) {
    if (ch == "-") return("⁻")
    return(names(superscripts)[superscripts == as.numeric(ch)])
  })
  
  paste0(coefficient, "×10", paste(exp_super, collapse = ""))
}

format_sci_unicode(1.0e-12)
# [1] "1 × 10⁻¹²"

format_sci_unicode(2.5e6)
# [1] "2.5 × 10⁶"
```

```{r}
df_correlation_change %>% 
  left_join(df_influence_summary, by = "criteria") %>% 
  mutate(
    r2_pct_contribution = round(r2_pct_contribution, 1),
    pval_without = signif(pval_without, 2),
    cook.d = round(cook.d, 2)
  ) %>% 
  select(
    Criteria = criteria, 
    "% of total R²" = r2_pct_contribution, 
    "P-value when excluded" = pval_without, 
    "Cook's distance" = cook.d)
```
